raw_text: Myanmar junta airstrikes hit Chin State near Indian border. Explosions heard across Champhai district in Mizoram. Local reports say Tatmadaw jets targeted resistance positions near Rihkhawdar. Fresh refugee influx into India expected. Indian Army units on the border placed on high alert. This is extremely close to Indian territory.
clean_text: Tatmadaw airstrikes in Chin State heard across Champhai, Mizoram. Indian Army on high alert. Fresh refugee influx expected.
